## Import data

```{r}
read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
penguins <- read.csv(file = "data/penguin_dataset.csv" )
 penguins |> head()
 penguins |> tail()
 penguins |> View()
 penguins |> summary()
 penguins |> colnames()
 penguins |> dim()

 head(penguins, 4)

penguins |> # start with the penguns and then
    na.omit() |> #remove the NAs and then
    arrange(bill_len) |> # arrange in rows and then
    head() #keep just the head (6 rows)

```

## GGplot for data visualisation

```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins, 
       mapping = aes(x =bill_len,
                     y=bill_dep)) + 
geom_point()

ggplot(data = penguins, 
       mapping = aes(x =bill_len,
                     y=bill_dep,
                     colour=species)) + 
geom_point()                        
```
